title: Ibushi challenges Nakamura’s strong style
summary: Kota Ibushi meets an admired standard-bearer in Shinsuke Nakamura. Their matches bring out a more aggressive side of Ibushi as he tries to compete on Nakamura’s terms.

chapters.title: The first G1 confrontation
chapters.context: Ibushi’s striking and defiance establish the relationship as more than a junior-heavyweight visitor facing an established star.

chapters.title: The Intercontinental title showdown
chapters.result: Nakamura defeats Ibushi to retain the Intercontinental championship.
chapters.context: Ibushi tests his idol on the Dome stage but cannot complete the breakthrough, leaving Nakamura as the standard he has yet to surpass.
